items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The text says the command came from the LORD, spoken to Moses, who was to pass it on.

items.quote: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep:
items.claim: Moses is told to tell the children of Israel that they must keep the LORD's sabbaths.
items.object: sabbaths; addressed to the children of Israel

items.quote: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
items.claim: Sabbath-keeping is described as a lasting sign between the LORD and Israel for all generations, so they will know the LORD is the one who sanctifies them.
items.mechanism: a practice kept across generations serves as a sign of the relationship and of sanctification
